scope: small-scale next-byte learning at the four-row shape; no useful text generation or contextual reasoning claim. The same pinned corpus and the same 512 held-out target bytes as the two-row schedule, read as four batches of four rows instead of eight batches of two, so the two shapes' held-out losses are means over the same text. This is a SEPARATE certificate: nine weight gradients contract over the token count, so 128 tokens a step is a different sum than 64, not a multiple of it.
